subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: Wealth brings a wealthy man of course A multimillionaire may have much attention His wealth usually needs much worry with happiness He is also a great responsibility There may be many estates and factories
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (i) Wealth needs much attention. (ii) A multimillionaire may be a wealthy man of course. (iii) His wealth usually brings much worry with happiness. (iv) He may have many estates and factories. (v) There is also a great responsibility.
